description.value: Red Swan Pizza is a Canadian gourmet pizza chain with a location in north Kamloops, offering fresh handmade pizzas with premium ingredients available for pickup or delivery. The menu extends beyond pizza to include pastas, salads, sides, and desserts, and the chain also offers catering for events. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops will find this a convenient stop for a hot meal or a takeout order.

address.value: 724 Sydney Avenue Unit 2, Kamloops, BC V2B 1M9
